# Settings

Every key in `~/.config/pomelo/settings.json`, with its default. Most are
edited in the Settings window (<Keys k="cmd-,"/>), on the page each section
below is named after; **Edit in settings.json** at the top of the window
opens the file itself. A missing key keeps its default, and keys this version
does not know are written back untouched, so a file from a newer version
survives.

Nested keys are written with dots here: `completions.lsp` is
`{"completions": {"lsp": true}}` in the file.

The keys under [Remote hosts](#remote-hosts) are on no page: set them in
settings.json, on the machine each one says.

The keys under [Kept by the app](#kept-by-the-app) record how you left the
window; they change as you use it and rarely need editing by hand.

## Appearance

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `"Pomelo Dark"` | The theme shown when `theme_selection` is `"static"`. |
| `theme_selection` | `"static"` | `"static"` always shows `theme`; `"dynamic"` picks `theme_light` or `theme_dark` by `theme_mode`. |
| `theme_mode` | `"system"` | With dynamic selection: `"light"`, `"dark"` or `"system"` (follow the macOS appearance). |
| `theme_light` | `"Pomelo Light"` | The theme used when light mode is active. |
| `theme_dark` | `"Pomelo Dark"` | The theme used when dark mode is active. |
| `theme_overrides` | `{}` | Per theme name, color tokens laid over that theme: `{"One Dark": {"editor.background": "#1e2127"}}`. |
| `buffer_font_family` | `".PomeloMono"` | Font family used for the code editor. |
| `buffer_font_size` | `13.0` | Text size of the code editor. |
| `buffer_font_weight` | `400.0` | Font weight for the code editor (100-900). |
| `buffer_line_height` | `1.54` | Line height for the code editor: `"comfortable"` (1.618), `"standard"` (1.3), a number or `{"custom": n}`. |
| `buffer_font_features` | `{}` | OpenType features for the code editor, by tag. |
| `buffer_font_fallbacks` | `[]` | Families tried, in order, for characters the editor font lacks. |
| `ui_font` | `".PomeloSans"` | Font family used for interface text. |
| `ui_font_size` | `16.0` | Font size for UI elements. |
| `ui_font_weight` | `400.0` | Font weight for UI elements (100-900). |
| `ui_font_features` | `{}` | OpenType features for UI text, by tag: `{"calt": false, "ss01": true}`. |
| `ui_font_fallbacks` | `[]` | Families tried, in order, for characters the UI font lacks. |
| `agent_font_size` | `12.0` | Text size of the agent's tabs, apart from terminals. |
| `terminal_font_family` | `".PomeloMono"` | Font family used for terminals. |
| `terminal_font_size` | `15.0` | Text size of terminals (the agent's tabs have `agent_font_size`). |
| `terminal_font_weight` | `400.0` | Font weight for terminals (100-900). |
| `terminal_line_height` | `"standard"` | Line height for terminals, in the same forms as `buffer_line_height`. |
| `terminal_font_features` | `{}` | OpenType features for terminals, by tag. |
| `terminal_font_fallbacks` | `[]` | Families tried, in order, for characters the terminal font lacks. |
| `multi_cursor_modifier` | `"alt"` | The key held to add a cursor with a click: `"alt"`, or `"cmd_or_ctrl"` (Alt-click then goes to the definition). |
| `cursor_blink` | `true` | Whether the cursor blinks in the editor. |
| `cursor_animation.enabled` | `false` | The cursor glides to where it moves instead of jumping. |
| `cursor_shape` | `"bar"` | `"bar"`, `"block"`, `"underline"` or `"hollow"`. |
| `hide_mouse` | `"on_typing_and_action"` | When the pointer hides until the mouse moves: `"never"`, `"on_typing"` or `"on_typing_and_action"`. |
| `reduce_motion` | `"off"` | `"on"` holds loading shimmers, pulsing placeholders and the cursor's glide still. |

## Window & Layout

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `func_hidden` | `[]` | Which status bar buttons are hidden, in the order Files, Services, Git, Database. |
| `terminal_hidden` | `false` | The terminal button is hidden from the status bar. |
| `agent_hidden` | `false` | The agent button is hidden from the status bar. |
| `show_diagnostics` | `true` | Show the error/warning count in the status bar. |
| `show_cursor_position` | `true` | Show the line and column of the cursor in the status bar. |
| `show_language` | `true` | Show the active language of the editor in the status bar. |
| `global_lsp_settings.button` | `true` | Show the language server button in the status bar. |
| `show_branch` | `true` | Show the active workspace's branch in the title bar. |
| `show_session_name` | `true` | Show the current session name in the title bar. |

## General

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `restore_on_startup` | `"last_session"` | `"last_session"` reopens each workspace's tabs from last time; `"none"` starts without them. |
| `auto_update` | `true` | The installed app checks for a newer release. Nothing installs until you restart. |

## Editor

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `soft_wrap` | `false` | Newly opened files wrap long lines at the editor's width. |
| `split_diff` | `true` | Diffs open side by side when the pane is wide enough, else in one column. |
| `external_editor` | `""` | The app "Open in External Editor" uses; empty picks the first one installed. |
| `remote_editor` | `""` | The command "Open in Editor" runs for a project on another machine, with `{host}` (user@host[:port] from hosts.json), `{path}` (the worktree there) and `{url}` (`ssh://{host}/{path}`) filled in; empty runs `zed {url}` if `zed` is installed, else `code --remote ssh-remote+{host} {path}`. |

## Languages & Tools

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enable_language_server` | `true` | Language servers start for the languages they serve; off, none does. |
| `language_servers` | `["..."]` | Which servers a language uses, in order: a name turns one on, `!name` turns it off, `...` stands for the rest of its defaults. |
| `completions.lsp` | `true` | Language servers are asked for completions. |
| `completions.lsp_fetch_timeout_ms` | `0` | How long to wait for a server's completions, in milliseconds; 0 waits for them. |
| `go_to_definition_scroll_strategy` | `"center"` | Where a definition lands in view: `"center"`, `"minimum"`, `"top"` or `"preserve"`. |
| `diagnostics_max_severity` | `"all"` | The least severe diagnostic shown: `"off"`, `"error"`, `"warning"`, `"info"`, `"hint"` or `"all"`. |
| `diagnostics.inline.enabled` | `false` | New editors show each line's diagnostic at its end. |
| `diagnostics.inline.padding` | `4` | Columns between a line's end and its diagnostic. |
| `diagnostics.inline.min_column` | `0` | The column inline diagnostics line up at, when the line is shorter. |
| `file_types` | `{}` | Language names to the file names, extensions or `*` globs that are that language, over detection: `{"JSON": ["*.jsonc"]}`. |
| `languages` | `{}` | Per language name, settings over the shared ones: `enable_language_server`, `language_servers` and `completions` (`lsp`, `lsp_fetch_timeout_ms`). Unset keys keep the shared value. |

## Agent

| Key | Default | Description |

| `agent_command` | `"claude"` | The AI CLI the Agent button opens in a workspace; `claude` also gets pom's MCP server and prompt. |
| `agent_open_in` | `"dock"` | Where agents open: `"dock"` in the agent dock, `"center"` as a tab next to the code. |
| `agent_tab_close` | `"hide"` | Closing an agent's tab: `"hide"` leaves the agent running, `"stop"` ends it. |

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notify_claude` | `true` | Banners and sounds when a workspace's Claude starts, finishes, needs input or compacts. Needs macOS notification permission. |
| `notify_when_focused` | `false` | Also alert for the workspace on screen in the focused window. |
| `sound_working` | `""` | The macOS sound played when an agent starts working; empty plays nothing. |
| `sound_finished` | `"Glass"` | The macOS sound played when an agent finishes; empty plays nothing. |

| `sound_compacting` | `""` | The macOS sound played when an agent compacts its context; empty plays nothing. |

## Dev Services

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dev_proxy_enabled` | `true` | Run the dev proxy while a project is open. |
| `dev_proxy_port` | `8767` | The dev proxy's port: a service opens at `<service>.<repo>.<ticket or branch>.localhost:<port>` (see `proxy.domain`). Restart running services after changing it. |
| `webhook_enabled` | `true` | Run the webhook relay while a project is open. |
| `webhook_port` | `8766` | The webhook relay's port: point an external webhook at `localhost:<port>/<repo>/<service>`. |
| `proxy.bind` | `"127.0.0.1"` | The address the dev proxy and webhook relay listen on besides loopback (`127.0.0.1` by default). Any other address lets other machines in, and the proxy has no authentication: use a private network (Tailscale, a LAN) or a reverse proxy. |
| `proxy.domain` | `"localhost"` | Service hosts end in it: `<service>.<repo>.<ticket or branch>.<domain>`; `localhost` hosts keep working. Changing it rewrites the env files; restart running services. |
| `proxy.public_scheme` | `"http"` | `"http"` or `"https"` (a reverse proxy in front terminates TLS): service URLs use it and cookies keep `Secure` under https. |
| `proxy.public_port` | `0` | The port in service URLs; 0 uses `dev_proxy_port`. 443 with https, or 80 with http, leaves the port out. |
| `proxy.trusted_proxies` | `[]` | Addresses or CIDR ranges (`["127.0.0.1", "100.64.0.0/10"]`) whose `X-Forwarded-Proto` and `X-Forwarded-Host` are believed; anyone else's are replaced. |
| `modules_store_enabled` | `true` | A new workspace whose lockfile matches a stored one takes its node_modules instead of installing. |
| `modules_fallback` | `"hardlink"` | Where a copy-on-write clone is impossible: `"hardlink"`, `"copy"` or `"install"` (skip the store). |
| `modules_size_limit_gb` | `20` | GB the node_modules store keeps at most; the least recently used copies go first. |
| `modules_unused_days` | `14` | Days a stored copy is kept without a workspace taking it (0 keeps them until the size limit). |

## Integrations

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `workspaces.auto_cleanup` | `"off"` | Workspaces whose pull requests all merged: `"off"` leaves them, `"ask"` offers to delete them, `"auto"` deletes them (not the one on screen). One with uncommitted or unpushed work is always kept. |
| `workspaces.idle_sleep_minutes` | `0` | Minutes a workspace may go without a dev proxy request or a working agent before it is put to sleep (`pom ws sleep`); 0 never. Checked once a minute by `pom proxy` and the app. |
| `workspaces.max_running` | `0` | How many workspaces may run at once on this machine; 0 any number. Starting or waking one more first puts the least recently used idle one to sleep; when none is idle it waits as `queued` and starts once one sleeps. |
| `jira_only_mine` | `false` | The new-workspace ticket picker lists only Jira tickets assigned to you. |
| `group_workspaces` | `false` | The WORKSPACES list is grouped under its tickets' statuses. |

## Remote hosts

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `server.idle_exit_minutes` | `30` | Minutes `pom server` keeps running on a remote host with no app connected before it exits; 0 never. Read from the host's own settings.json when the server starts. |
| `server.reconnect_retention_minutes` | `10` | Minutes `pom server` remembers the terminals of an app whose connection dropped, so a reconnect carries them on where they stopped. Read on the host when the server starts. |
| `server.unconfirmed_input_kib` | `64` | KiB of typed input the app keeps until the server has surely written it, and sends again after a dropped connection (the server drops what it already wrote). Read on this Mac when a remote project opens. |

## Kept by the app

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onboard_with_ai` | `true` | New projects are finished by the coding agent; off, you review the drafted pom.yml yourself. |
| `jira_board` | `0` | The Jira board the ticket picker opened on last (0: none yet). |
| `sidebar_side` | `"left"` | The dock the sidebar lives in: `"left"`, `"right"` or `"bottom"`. |
| `agent_side` | `"right"` | The dock the agent lives in. |
| `terminal_side` | `"bottom"` | The dock the terminal lives in. |
| `func_sides` | `[]` | The dock each status bar button lives in, in the order of `func_hidden`. |
| `left_dock_width` | `260.0` | Width of the left dock, in points. |
| `right_dock_width` | `300.0` | Width of the right dock, in points. |
| `left_dock_collapsed` | `false` | The left dock is closed. |
| `right_dock_collapsed` | `true` | The right dock is closed. |
| `bottom_dock_collapsed` | `false` | The bottom dock is closed. |
| `panels_collapsed` | `false` | The left panel column (Files, Services, ...) is closed. |
